summary: Kittitas County, WA lookout cab built 1932 in the Wenatchee NF, abandoned 1948; register and FFLOS both say it is now gone; L-5 vs L-6 cab model disputed.

facts.design: Cab on a site 17 miles NW of Cle Elum; model disputed (L-5 per register, L-6 per firelookout.com)
facts.status_note: Register says the cab is now gone; FFLOS Washington index lists the site as Gone; a photo on the register page is captioned Debris, but no source describes the site today

events.note: Built in 1932 per register; firelookout.com also gives 1932
Panoramic photographs labeled Red Mountain Lookout dated 8-22-1934, credited to National Archives Pacific Northwest Region
Cab abandoned in 1948 per register and firelookout.com
Registered October 28, 2012 as US 1420, WA 320; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: built in 1932 with an L-5 cab (register version)
evidence.quote: Built in 1932, this L-5 cab was abandoned in 1948 and is now gone.

evidence.supports: about 17 miles northwest of Cle Elum
1934 panoramic photographs credited to National Archives Pacific Northwest Region
evidence.quote: Red Mountain Lookout panoramic 8-22-1934 (N) - courtesy of National Archives-Pacific Northwest Region

evidence.supports: photo captioned Debris on the register page
FFLOS index lists the site as Gone
evidence.quote: Red Mountain Kittitas 47.30172 -120.76081 Ground Gone FFLOS US 1420, WA 320

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS Washington index gives US 1420 at 47.30172, -120.76081, but the register detail page gives 47.395217, -121.145450, which matches the firelookout.com description of 17 miles northwest of Cle Elum. The brief's coordinates follow the detail page.

sources.title: Red Mountain Lookout Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites (Forest Fire Lookout Association)

notes_for_editor: Model conflict unresolved: register says L-5 cab, firelookout.com says L-6; story reports both. FFLOS index types the site as Ground. Name collision: WTA's Red Mountain Lookout (https://www.wta.org/go-hiking/hikes/red-mountain-lookout-1, 48.0583 -121.2879, Glacier Peak Wilderness) and willhiteweb's North Fork Sauk Red Mountain are different sites and were excluded. No staffing, fires, or access information found in the sources read; no photo URLs added because the register's photo credits came without image URLs.
